headlines.description: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Joe Flacco was dazed and bleeding as he was helped off the field.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens lose Flacco, beat Dolphins 40-0 behind defense

headlines.description: Case Keenum threw for two touchdowns and Kai Forbath made four field goals as the Minnesota Vikings defeated the Cleveland Browns 33-16 at Twickenham Stadium in the last of four games held this season in Britain.
headlines.shortLinkText: Keenum, Forbath help Vikings win 33-16 vs. Browns in London

headlines.description: Rookie linebacker Matt Milano scored on a 40-yard fumble return on a rain-slick field, and the Buffalo Bills forced four turnovers in beating the Oakland Raiders 34-14 on Sunday.

Lineman Carlos Dunlap batted Jacoby Brissett's pass into the air, grabbed the ball and ran 16 yards to the end zone for a game-turning touchdown Sunday, rallying the Cincinnati Bengals to a 24-23 victory over the Indianapolis Colts.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dunlap's interception rallies Bengals over Colts 24-23

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady passed for 333 yards and a touchdown, Stephen Gostkowski added four field goals and the New England Patriots held on to beat the Los Angeles Chargers 21-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots capitalize on Chargers' mistakes in 21-13 win

events.name: Chicago Bears at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees completed 23 of 28 passes for 299 yards against a Bears defense that ranked sixth against the pass, and the New Orleans Saints beat Chicago 20-12 Sunday for their fifth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees leads Saints past Bears, 20-12, for 5th straight win

events.name: Atlanta Falcons at New York Jets

headlines.description: Matt Ryan threw two touchdown passes, and the Atlanta Falcons slipped and slid to a 25-20 victory over the New York Jets on a soggy Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ryan, Falcons slip and slide to 25-20 win over Jets

headlines.description: Carson Wentz tossed two touchdown passes, Jalen Mills had a pick-6 and the NFL-leading Philadelphia Eagles beat the winless San Francisco 49ers 33-10 on a sloppy, rainy Sunday.

events.name: Carolina Panthers at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 154 yards and one touchdown and Carolina's defense didn't allow a TD for the second straight week, helping the Panthers snap a two-game losing streak with a 17-3 victory over the struggling Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton, Carolina defense lead Panthers past Buccaneers 17-3

headlines.description: Ezekiel Elliott ran for 150 yards and two touchdowns, and the Dallas Cowboys took advantage of a blocked field goal return and three turnovers to beat the Washington Redskins 33-19 Sunday and move into sole possession of second place in the NFC East.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys 'Feed Zeke,' capitalize on mistakes to beat Redskins

headlines.description: JuJu Smith-Schuster scored on a 97-yard touchdown pass from Ben Roethlisberger late in the third quarter, and the Pittsburgh Steelers forced the Detroit Lions to turn the ball over on downs twice in a 20-15 win Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers lean on D, Smith-Schuster in 20-15 win over Lions

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Harrison Butker kicked five field goals, Marcus Peters returned a fumble 45 yards for a touchdown and the Kansas City Chiefs beat the turnover-prone Denver Broncos 29-19 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs force 5 TOs, beat Broncos 29-19 in AFC West showdown
